body.statement: Fix \(p\), \(C\in\mathfrak S_p\), and \(\theta_C\in\Theta_C\setminus\mathcal E_C\), and put \(\Sigma_0=\phi_C(\theta_C)\). Let \(X^{(1)},\ldots,X^{(n)}\) be independent \(N_p(0,\Sigma_0)\) observations, and let \(\widehat C_n\) minimize \(\operatorname{BIC}_n\) over \(\mathfrak S_p\) under the fixed tie rule. The set \(\mathcal E_C\) is a proper algebraic subset of \(\Theta_C\), and as \(n\to\infty\) with fixed \(p\), \[\Pr\{\mathcal R(\widehat C_n)=\mathcal R(C)\}\longrightarrow1.\] The result concerns the global criterion and makes no claim about greedy-search consistency.
body.justification: Singleton blocks change the estimable structure from one state to an exact image quotient, so likelihood ties must be handled at the component level.
body.gap: BoegeKubjasMisraSolus2026, Section 6 and Discussion, derives decomposable BIC and reports GECS simulations but leaves consistency open; Haughton1988 treats a fixed finite collection of smooth models without this equality quotient and its algebraic intersections.
body.consumer: A fixed-dimensional coloured-DAG analysis can consistently report the correct observational component despite exact likelihood ties among its members.
